text:
Ivy: Heads-up  support flagged that our Optimize toolkit batching page mixes English-only snippets and a few hard-coded token estimates that confuse international teams. Opening a focused PR to: 1) add i18n-friendly examples (decimal/comma token counts), 2) fix a stray link to examples/old/auto-batch.md, and 3) add a migration note for the deprecated auto-batch flag. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5128 :earth_americas:
Soren: Good catch. Which pages exactly?
Ivy: /optimize/batching/guide.md, /optimize/cache/intro.md, and examples/snippets/batching_profiles.yaml. The old auto-batch setting is mentioned in two places: guide.md and a legacy snippet in examples/legacy/auto-batch-example.md.
Pat: Can you paste the old auto-batch snippet? Want to be sure we recommend the right replacement.
Ivy: Old snippet (legacy):

```yaml
# legacy auto-batch example
batching:
  auto-batch: true
  max_batch_size: 128
```

Ivy: New recommendation is explicit profiles + route overrides, e.g.:

```yaml
# recommended (explicit profiles)
batching:
  profiles:
    short-seq:
      batch_size: 8
      max_tokens: 128
    long-seq:
      batch_size: 64
      max_tokens: 4096
routes:
  /summaries:
    batching_profile: short-seq
  /batch-embed:
    batching_profile: long-seq
```

Yuki: Nice. Also mention that locales use different formatting for numbers, we should show both 1,000 and 1.000 examples in comments and call out that token distributions are estimates.
Ivy: Added a small comment block in the YAML showing both formats and a brief note: "Token counts are estimates; bench in your region/hardware."
Soren: We should also update the quant profiles page to recommend profile variants for non-Latin languages (longer tokenization). Suggest calling out `q_profile_international` with example settings (higher max_tokens, smaller batch_size) and an explicit migration note for users who used auto-batch hoping it would adapt to tokenization differences.
Ivy: Added `q_profile_international` sample and a migration blurb at top: "If you relied on auto-batch for tokenization variance, migrate to per-route profiles and the supplied `q_profile_international` for better throughput/cost trade-offs."
Pat: Can you also add a tiny code snippet for the SDK showing how to select profiles per request? Many examples show only server config.
Ivy: Added Python and Node request-time snippets:

```python
# python per-request override
resp = client.generate(model='rwr/small', input='...', batching_profile='short-seq')
```

```js
// node per-request override
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'rwr/small', input: '...', batching_profile: 'long-seq' })
```

Yuki: For Node example, add a note about Node 18+ for top-level await / for-await streaming. Also, include a short Dedicated deployment callout: "Dedicated customers can set per-pool defaults in the console."
Ivy: Included both notes and added a redirect for examples/old/auto-batch.md -> examples/legacy/auto-batch-redirect.md. Also updated links in guide.md that pointed to the moved examples.
Soren: One more operational ask: add a docs-lint rule that searches for `auto-batch` and fails the PR if found (so we don't reintroduce it). Make it warn-only for a week then strict. I can add the GH Action.
Ivy: Great  please add that to the PR checklist. Also added a small changelog entry under "docs: remove auto-batch references; add international profile guidance."
DocsBot: Automated note: PR 5128 opened by Ivy; reviewers: Soren, Pat, Yuki. Docs CI: link-checker + yaml-validate queued.
Pat: I'll review the profile names and the SDK snippets later today. If all good, aim to merge by Thursday.
Ivy: Thanks  ping me if you find any remaining `auto-batch` mentions.
